description: Save an event's website-builder draft. `config` is the website-builder JSON (sections + theme — best obtained by reading get_website and editing it, or by asking the user for what they want built). Optional `slug` claims or renames the site address (3–40 chars: lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens; check with check_website_slug first — taken slugs fail with 409, and old slugs stay reserved forever when renaming so printed links keep working). Publishing is a separate step (publish_website).
name: save_website
title: Save event website
